answer: The Phone SIM bound by one-time code delivery with annual re-verification makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the phone sim answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Trust here is built the way a thread is built: slowly, binding by binding, and easy to lose. Whether the proof comes from a mirror or a pulse, the verification step is identical and public.
